in_sanskrit.name: Monti
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Little Mountain
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Monti एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'manta', meaning 'mountain'. In Hindu mythology, Monti is an alternative name for Lord Hanuman, who is known as the 'Monkey God' and the 'Mountain-Mover'.

In Hindu mythology, Monti is an alternative name for Lord Hanuman, who is known as the 'Monkey God' and the 'Mountain-Mover'.
